title: FindingRecord
description: Consumer: ops.mjs finding add/disposition; embedded in run-state.schema.json's findings[] array. Renamed from an earlier finding.schema.json to match the canonical name.

category.description: A..R: A=internal code, B=business rule, C=internal contract, D=external contract, E=database/persistence, F=user interface, G=security, H=performance, I=reliability, J=observability, K=test, L=configuration, M=infrastructure, N=historical/legacy, O=generated code, P=documentation, Q=historical data, R=build/cache artifact

fingerprint.description: Correlation key (see lib/finding-correlation.mjs) letting multiple tool results (OSV, npm audit, CodeQL, a reviewer) that detected the SAME underlying problem collapse into one canonical finding instead of duplicating it. Optional — absent for hand-written findings that never went through correlation.

sources.description: Which tool(s)/reviewer(s) contributed evidence to this finding (e.g. ["osv-scanner", "npm-audit"]) — populated by lib/finding-correlation.mjs when two+ raw results correlate to the same fingerprint. Optional.
